anomalies.impact: The display SCL clock is driven through an always-enabled non-inverting buffer instead of directly by the MCU. The MCU pin is not on the I2C SCL net, and the pull-up R6 is on the buffer output rather than on the MCU-side input. If PB13 is configured as open-drain I2C, the buffer input will float when the MCU releases SCL, likely causing display communication failure or erratic SCL behavior.
